principle: LLMs maintain candidate knowledge organization; deterministic gates sign releases and protect authority.

actions.action: Backfill exam taxonomy/analysis/score candidate gaps before signed grading release.
actions.pass_criteria: source chunk evidence, rubric refs, score cap validation, official_score_allowed remains false

actions.action: Run PDF compiler or mapping workflow for the P1 queue before any release signing.
actions.pass_criteria: source hash, page/chunk provenance, schema validation, OCR quality or mapping proof

actions.action: Backfill sub-question-level source alignment for the 16 case-level-only cases.
actions.pass_criteria: case/sub-question count, source chunk anchors, rubric refs, score cap validation

actions.action: Create signed release-candidate review pack; do not promote candidate scope directly.
actions.pass_criteria: schema validation, source verification, adversarial scoring guard, signed release pointer

actions.action: Decide whether to publish/sign the bank or change the reader default to a published pointer path.
actions.pass_criteria: reader default, pointer policy, hash/schema gate, rollback behavior, and test evidence agree

actions.action: For each published pointer, run or record a true consumer read proof before calling it runtime-ready.
actions.pass_criteria: consumer smoke/trace, hash match, schema gate, rollback verification

actions.action: Backfill PDF->JSON provenance map for candidate derivatives.
actions.pass_criteria: PDF hash, derivative JSON hash, page/chunk anchors, manual or scripted provenance proof

actions.action: Review source claims by bucket, prioritizing exam, standard, textbook, and taxonomy before lectures.
actions.pass_criteria: file hash, source path, bucket policy, schema shape, human or scripted claim review

actions.action: Review candidate/blocked pointers one by one; publish only via signed gate.
actions.pass_criteria: published flag, content hash, schema, signed owner decision, rollback pointer
